title: Characterization of tree NC
statement: For every language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet, $L$ belongs to the union of the tree-circuit classes with depth exponent at least one if and only if there is an integer $i\ge 1$ and a family of Boolean circuit trees recognizing exactly $L$ whose fan-in is at most two, whose size is polynomial in the input length, and whose depth is bounded by a polynomial in $\log n+1$ of degree $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
